# Overview

Provide a summary of your change, requirements, and implementation choices made in this PR.

## JIRA Ticket

Include the link for the JIRA ticket. This helps trace the changes to original problems or feature requests.

[TicketNumber](https://prospa.atlassian.net/browse/${TicketNumber})

## Maestro Impact

- [ ] No UI change
- [ ] UI changed and Maestro tests were updated
- [ ] UI changed but no Maestro update was needed

### If no Maestro update was needed or an exemption applies

Explain why the existing Maestro coverage is still valid.

### Maestro flows checked or updated

List the impacted flow names or page objects under `apps/mobile-app/e2e-tests/.maestro/`.

## QA Checklist

- [ ] Relevant `testID`s were kept stable or updated
